title: Evidence of a secret deal between Freddy Johnson and Canetti
summary: Guitarist Sterling Conaway found proof of a private arrangement between Johnson and Canetti, causing dissension among players who had quit jobs to tour.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Then, we realized after that there
was something wrong between Canetti and some kind of a secret engagement, arrangement between Freddy and Canetti.
Right. Some of the boys found that out. Exactly who it is, I tell you it was-- he has -- and the majority of them have all passed, now.

Sterling Conaway, one of our best guitar players, and one of the most true blues you can find, and then he came back, and he told us, he said, "I have the proof," and that caused a little dissension in the orchestra.
And, Canetti had made many arrangements, and the majority of us, we had jobs, you see. We were all working somewhere.
I was still at Bricktop's and doubling at Ciro's, and he was in some other

club, but they all had jobs.
And they had quit their jobs
to go on the road with Canetti and then
Freddie's set up.
